degree.text: Degree Awarded Master’s Degree in Management

description.text: Teaching Objectives To learn the basic theory and knowledge in the field of accounting, auditing and business administration and get trained in the basic skills in accounting and auditing. Expected to have reasonable strong ability to analyze and solve problems in accounting and auditing field. Major Courses Management Accounting and Auditing,Financial Management,Finance (National Key Discipline), Money and Banking (Provincial Quality Courses), Management Science, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Information Management System, Statistics, Accounting, Marketing, Economic Law, Financial Accounting, Cost Accounting. Internship They will be qualified upon graduation for auditing jobs in certified accountant offices both at home and abroad. Degree Awarded Master’s Degree in Management Future Career In commercial enterprises as accountant and financial affairs executive.

duration.text: The Accounting at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Undergraduate school transcript Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Bachelor's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
